purpose: Deterministic build/supply-chain/runtime-surface enrichment layered on the content-addressed semantic repository graph.

cache_freshness.tracked_workspace_identity: Git index tree plus tracked worktree status and content hashes for unstaged changed files
cache_freshness.read_rule: A schema-5 snapshot may be reused only when its workspace fingerprint matches and all required companion outputs exist.
cache_freshness.concurrent_mutation_rule: If tracked state changes during snapshot construction, publication fails rather than emitting a mixed-state index.

relationship_fidelity.metadata_variant_policy: preserve distinct scopes, requirements, commands and other relation metadata even when from/to/type are identical
relationship_fidelity.reverse_edges: retain relation metadata needed to distinguish incoming variants

non_claims: no vulnerability status without GitHub/Dependabot evidence
no license conclusion inferred from package names

surface_semantics.routes: FastAPI-style decorator routes and Expo file routes are discoverability evidence, not endpoint reachability proof.
surface_semantics.environment: Only variable names and source reference paths are indexed; values are never emitted.

hotspot_semantics.non_claim: not a code quality, security, competence, or SOTA score

batch_semantics.evidence-noted: At least one tracked handoff note references the batch ID; this does not establish completion or readiness.

search_semantics.core: deterministic lexical retrieval over paths, symbols, imports, routes, env names, dependency declarations and subsystems

determinism: Age/freshness is measured relative to HEAD commit time, never wall-clock time. History is bounded to the declared commit window.
